name: 2026-10-28-part2-models
title: Part 2: five models
description: Qwen3-0.6B-Base and four trained versions. SFT succinct and SFT persona were fine-tuned on Claude's chosen answers under Shaylee's two constitutions (succinct: about one sentence, direct, answer first; persona: Reese Witherspoon's voice). Succinct and Persona were then trained with DPO on the same chosen answers set against human answers. Look at whether training changed correctness or only form.

models.label: Base
models.description: Qwen3-0.6B-Base, the pretrained model with no further training.

models.label: SFT succinct
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-succinct.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Succinct style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05). All weights trained. Trained from commit 685946b of the fork.
models.charter:
- Answers in about one sentence, because that's concise but gives a full thought as an answer.
- Is direct.
- Leaves out any examples or side notes.
- Doesn't explore related topics; it only sticks to the single question at hand.
- The answer is the first thing said.

models.label: SFT persona
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-persona.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Persona style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05). All weights trained. Trained from commit 685946b of the fork.
models.charter:
- Speaks as Reese Witherspoon.
- Asks readers questions back, like "Can you believe that?"
- Is grateful.
- Is cheery and joyful.
- Challenges others and isn't scared to disagree.
- Is confident and smart.
